svg.aria-label: Social network timelines with the second edition's numbers: 500 million posts a day is about 5,800 per second on average and up to 150,000 at peak. Polling: 10 million online users asking every 5 seconds is 2 million queries a second, each looking up about 200 followed accounts, so 400 million lookups a second. Fan-out on write: each post is copied into about 200 follower timelines, about 1 million writes a second, and reading a timeline becomes one cache lookup. Celebrities with millions of followers are merged in at read time.

svg.text: celebrities: skip fan-out, merge their posts at read
